**🩺 Stability & Availability** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win**

**Bound `xargs -P 0` parallelism.**

`-P 0` runs as many concurrent `perl` processes as there are batches. The batch size is 32 files. A large corpus therefore spawns many processes at once. This can exhaust memory or process limits on CI runners and developer machines. The old `nproc` limit prevented this. Restore a bounded value.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-scanner_jobs unset
+scanner_jobs=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN 2>/dev/null || echo 4)
...
-        xargs -0 -r -n "$scanner_batch_size" -P 0 \
+        xargs -0 -r -n "$scanner_batch_size" -P "$scanner_jobs" \
```
</details>
